planted.sourceSentence: At the end of the Initial Term, this Agreement will automatically renew for successive thirty-six (36) month periods (each a “Renewal Term”) unless you send us written notice of non-renewal by certified mail no more than 120 days and no less than 90 days before the end of the then-current term.

If any amount is not paid within five (5) days after its due date, you will owe a late fee of $75 for each missed payment plus interest on the unpaid balance at 1.5% per month, as set out in the Fee Shedule.

In consideration of Kestrelmoor providing the Services, the individual who signs the Order Form on behalf of Customer personally, unconditionally and irrevocably guarantees the full and prompt payment of all amounts Customer owes under this Agreement, now or in the future, and agrees that Kestrelmoor may collect those amounts from the guarantor’s personal assets without first pursuing Customer.

You will defend, indemnify and hold harmless Kestrelmoor and its officers, employees and agents from and against any and all claims, losses, damages, fines and expenses, including attorneys’ fees, arising out of or relating to your use of the Services, whether or not caused in part by Kestrelmoor’s own negligence.
In no event will Kestrelmoor’s total liability to you for any claim arising out of this Agreement exceed the subscription Fees you paid in the one (1) month before the event giving rise to the claim.

Any dispute, claim or controversy arising out of or relating to this Agreement or the Services (a “Dispute”) will be resolved exclusively by final and binding arbitration administered by a private arbitration provider chosen by Kestrelmoor, and you waive any right to a jury trial and any right to bring or take part in a class action, class arbitration or other
representative proceeding against Kestrelmoor.
